name: VEILBOUND M19 reference-driven human realism
reference: User-approved photorealistic adult male character sheet: four full-body turnaround angles; muscular but plausible, natural skin, realistic short dark hair, expressive facial structure, individual five-digit hands and feet, plain charcoal shorts. Reference image is a visual benchmark, not an editable 3D mesh.

guardrails.minimum_success: actual test report plus Android screenshot; manual visual review
guardrails.not_a_success: successful compilation alone, triangle-count increase alone, AI screenshot claim without image access

priority_order.goal: Remove disconnected loft look: continuous body topology and shoulder-neck-hip silhouettes. Human proportions 7.4-7.9 heads tall; no plated or armored geometry.
priority_order.acceptance: one body shell with continuous welded topology across torso/arms/legs, watertight-except-intended cuffs; indexed export test and before/after studio render

priority_order.goal: Resculpt head using jaw, cheekbones, eye sockets, ears, nose, lips, brow and realistic scalp proportions. Five fingers on each hand, five toes on each foot.
priority_order.acceptance: front/side profile screenshots, facial region silhouette review, individual fingers and toes verified on mesh

priority_order.goal: Preserve M18 bind pose; add pelvis, spine, neck and elbow/knee blended skinning, shoulder counterrotation, planted footsteps.
priority_order.acceptance: rest-pose reconstruction error <0.0001, smooth deformation under sample bends, no elbow or knee tearing

priority_order.goal: Nonmetal original skin albedo, subtle epidermal variation, skin micro-normal, roughness map, separately colored hair and shorts.
priority_order.acceptance: nonmetal skin classification, stable UVs, visual skin test in four lighting modes

priority_order.goal: Record reproducible FRONT, SIDE, BACK and 3/4 human captures on same framing; log triangles, bounds, camera values and texture dimensions.
priority_order.acceptance: four real PNG screenshots generated by emulator, model visible, app running without GL errors

priority_order.goal: Single APK tested by four synchronized Android 15 emulators; retain the M18 working game and never auto-merge.
priority_order.acceptance: all four individual reports, matching APK checksum, no placeholder/blank frames
